name: Band Bayesian Curl
cardText:
Band Bayesian Curl
Beginner
1
Attach band to a low anchor point. Point your palms straight forward.
2
Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

name: Band Row
cardText:
Band Row
Novice
1
Stand on your band with both feet.
2
Hinge forward at the hips while keeping a flat back.
3
Let your arms hang freely, then pull your elbows straight back toward the ceiling.

name: Band Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
cardText:
Band Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
Novice
1
Place the band at about eye level. Fall into a kneeling position.
2
The knee that is on the ground should be the same side as the working arm. Stick your chest out.
3
And then pull your elbow straight back. Flex your lats and then extend into the starting position.

name: Band Bayesian Hammer Curl
cardText:
Band Bayesian Hammer Curl
Intermediate
1
Attach band to a low anchor point. Use a neutral grip.
2
Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

name: Band Bayesian Reverse Curl
cardText:
Band Bayesian Reverse Curl
Beginner
1
Attach band to a low anchor point. . Point your palms toward your thighs.
2
Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

name: Band High Curl
cardText:
Band High Curl
Novice
1
Anchor a band to a high point.
2
Start with your feet staggered and your elbows high.
3
Flex your elbows while keeping your arms high. Curl the band to your forehead.

name: Band High Hammer Curl
cardText:
Band High Hammer Curl
Novice
1
Start with the band anchored to something high with your feet staggered and a neutral grip.
2
Keep your elbows high. Curl until your fists are at your forehead.

name: Band High Reverse Curl
cardText:
Band High Reverse Curl
Novice
1
Start with a band attached to a high point, your feet staggered, and an overhand grip.
2
Flex your elbows pulling your forearms to your biceps. Your fists should land by your forehead.

name: Band Curl
cardText:
Band Curl
Novice
1
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, with the band under both feet.
2
Grasp the handles of the band with both hands, keeping your arms straight and extended in front of you.
3
Keep your back straight, abs engaged, and shoulders relaxed as you curl your hands towards your shoulders, bending at the elbows.

name: Band Reverse Curl
cardText:
Band Reverse Curl
Novice
1
Start by standing on the center of the band with both feet, shoulder-width apart.
2
Hold the band with both hands, palms facing down, arms extended straight in front of you.
3
Slowly curl your hands towards your shoulders, pulling the band tight, then lower your arms back to the starting position, keeping tension on the band throughout the exercise.

name: Band Squat Hold Single Arm Row
cardText:
Band Squat Hold Single Arm Row
Novice
1
Anchor the band to a stable point and take a half squat position.
2
Hold the band loop in one hand and pull your elbow straight back.

name: Band Squat Hold Row
cardText:
Band Squat Hold Row
Novice
1
Anchor the band to a stable point.
2
Take a half squat position and hold there.
3
Perform a row while holding the squat position.

name: Band Single Arm Pulldown
cardText:
Band Single Arm Pulldown
Novice
1
Anchor the band to a high point. Go into a seated position.
2
Grab the loop of the band and pull your upper arm to your side.

name: Band Single Arm Row
cardText:
Band Single Arm Row
Novice
1
Anchor band to a stable point.
2
Step back until there is no slack in the band and hold the end of the band with one hand.
3
Pull through the elbow straight back.

name: Band Single Arm Bent Over Row
cardText:
Band Single Arm Bent Over Row
Novice
1
Stand on band and hinge at hips, holding handle with arm extended.
2
Pull elbow toward your hip, keeping back flat and shoulders square.
3
Squeeze back at the top, then lower slowly to full stretch.

name: Band Bent Over Row
cardText:
Band Bent Over Row
Beginner
1
Stand on band with feet hip-width, holding handles with palms facing in.
2
Hinge at hips, keeping back flat and elbows close to ribs.
3
Pull handles toward torso, squeeze back, then lower slowly with control.

name: Band Pull Around
cardText:
Band Pull Around
Novice
1
Stand sideways to anchor and hold band with arm slightly extended.
2
Pull arm across your body in a smooth arc without rotating torso.
3
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly with control.

name: Mini Band Bent Over Row
cardText:
Mini Band Bent Over Row
Novice
1
Stand on band, hinge forward with flat back.
2
Stand on band, hinge forward with flat back.
3
Lower under control, maintaining core tension.

name: Mini Band Kneeling Row
cardText:
Mini Band Kneeling Row
Novice
1
Anchor band around foot, kneel tall holding ends.
2
Row elbow back, squeezing shoulder blades together.
3
Return slowly, maintaining upright torso.
